Name: Smart Crop /smart-crop
Notes: The route offers center, rule-of-thirds, and approximate edge-energy/colour-variation saliency placements. Ratio and placement options use a Zod schema and shared generated-control renderer; original-ratio/center is the no-op default and keyboard selection is covered in route E2E. Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit route E2E now covers all nine declared input/decode/canvas/export error kinds. A generated 12 MP square-crop preview measured 1427.8 ms median over five local Chromium runs (1416.8–1467.1 ms); a 3 s threshold is asserted in the route test. P4-21 has a reproducible 12-case benchmark on four individually registered CC0 images against subjective manual target boxes: mean retention 89.82%, 76.70%, and 71.97% respectively. The heuristic does not recognize subjects or faces; broad-device performance, visual quality, user preference, broader annotations, and route-level STCC remain open

Name: Upscale /upscale
Notes: Tier 1 DCCI/NEDI runs locally in a worker with bounded PNG input/output, preview, and export. Tier 2 is user-started with size/progress/cancel, registered byte-count/SHA-256 validation, IndexedDB reuse, browser inference probe, and Tier 1 recovery. Focused Chromium route E2E verifies registered x2 delivery progress and size/SHA-256 checks, actual x2 inference from a 3×2 PNG to 6×4 and x4 inference to 12×8, host-unavailable IndexedDB reuse after reload for x2, rejection of same-size hash corruption, and no caching of cancelled partial bytes. Odd inputs are edge-padded for model inference and cropped to the requested output size. The pinned Hugging Face x2/x4 exports passed full cross-origin Chromium CORS fetch/hash checks, CPU parity, and WASM smoke; Docker uses runtime URL overrides/fallbacks and never downloads model files. Full offline app-shell/worker behavior, production-host durability, representative performance/quality, and full STCC remain open. Synthetic comparisons do not show a Tier 1 quality advantage; Swin2SR remains evaluation-only

Name: Denoise /denoise
Notes: P4-21 measures the production median and bilateral methods on 12 deterministic 128x128 noise cases derived from four item-verified CC0 crops; fixture/output hashes, PSNR/SSIM, and CPU latency are recorded. These controlled corruptions are not sensor-noise or broad photo-quality evidence. Wavelet/BayesShrink is not implemented, NLM remains excluded, and /denoise route STCC is open

Name: OCR /ocr
Notes: Standalone /ocr route exposes 124 language/variant choices, 37 script models, OSD orientation/script results, and equation transcription; installed Edge has six route checks including 270-degree orientation correction and OCR/download. Rebuilt Chromium OCR E2E suite passed 12/12 with only bundled Cyrillic in static tessdata. Missing English used the exact pinned CDN fallback; bundled Cyrillic OCR, on-demand OSD, forced CDN-failure recovery, Arabic/pseudo selector labels, and keyboard-only selection/recognition/download passed. A fresh empty-cache orientation E2E confirmed page entry makes no traineddata requests and selecting orientation fetches only the pinned OSD model. After all eight measured language models were warmed online, each offline recognition returned exactly the same text and no external request occurred in the same page. Tesseract resolves local-first to registered files or pinned sources; the oversized 89,384,811-byte Latin script model uses its hash-verified pinned raw GitHub source because jsDelivr returns 403, while Cyrillic is the sole bundled file. Metadata-only HEAD checks pass for 161 jsDelivr entries. All 163 official tree entries are pinned/registered; accuracy still covers only eight persisted print fixtures (7 exact, Hindi CER 0.0588, mean CER 0.00735); Hausa is absent and rejected before fetch. Fresh-page offline startup, expanded-catalogue accuracy, and full STCC remain open.
